errors.evidence: The description states there are eight language family categories on the horizontal axis, but there are nine shown in the figure (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic).
The description incorrectly combines a category label 'IE-Slavic' with the overall axis label 'family'. The category label is just 'IE-Slavic'.
